metrics.statement: 指标[在贷客户数] (active_customer_count) 业务定义: No dedicated OD; grain OD-01 signed but customer uniqueness rules unsigned. 公式: COUNT(DISTINCT KHM)
指标[余额环比变化率] (balance_mom_pct_change) 业务定义: MoM helper; no dedicated OD. 公式: (loan_balance_amount_t - loan_balance_amount_t1) / loan_balance_amount_t1 * 100
指标[户均余额（元）] (avg_balance_per_customer) 业务定义: No dedicated OD. 公式: loan_balance_amount / active_customer_count

指标[TopN 绝对变化覆盖率] (abs_balance_change_coverage_topn) 业务定义: Descriptive helper (P25-4). Use when total signed balance change ≈ 0 would make delta_i/total_delta unstable. Never fabricate extreme ratios from near-zero signed total_delta.
 公式: sum(|balance_change_i| for top_n) / sum(|balance_change_j| for all products)
指标[方向贡献份额] (directional_balance_change_share) 业务定义: Descriptive share of absolute total change; not causal effect. Not Owner-signed. 公式: balance_change_i / sum(|balance_change_j| for all products)
指标[余额逾期率] (overdue_balance_rate) 业务定义: Owner-confirmed primary overdue balance rate 公式: SUM(YQDKYE)/NULLIF(SUM(DKYE),0)*100
指标[逾期客户率] (overdue_customer_rate) 业务定义: Owner-confirmed secondary customer overdue rate 公式: overdue_customers/active_customers*100
指标[在贷余额（元）] (loan_balance_amount) 公式: SUM(DKYE)
指标[在贷余额（亿元）] (loan_balance_yi) 业务定义: Display-only transform; source of truth remains loan_balance_amount in yuan. 公式: yuan_to_yi(loan_balance_amount)
指标[逾期余额（元）] (overdue_balance_amount) 公式: SUM(YQDKYE)
指标[不良余额（元）] (npl_balance_amount) 业务定义: Owner-approved NPL balance per OD-05. 公式: SUM(NVL(WJFLCJ,0) + NVL(WJFLKY,0) + NVL(WJFLSS,0))

指标[逾期客户数] (overdue_customer_count) 业务定义: Owner OD-03 prefers YQDKYE > 0 over legacy YQCS > 0 for overdue customer count. Legacy server.py still uses YQCS — track as implementation debt.
 公式: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN YQDKYE > 0 THEN KHM END)
指标[不良客户数] (npl_customer_count) 公式: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NVL(WJFLCJ,0)+NVL(WJFLKY,0)+NVL(WJFLSS,0) > 0 THEN KHM END)
指标[余额不良率] (npl_balance_rate) 业务定义: Primary NPL rate per OD-05. Dashboard legacy card id npl_rate aliases here. 公式: npl_balance_amount / loan_balance_amount * 100
指标[不良客户率] (npl_customer_rate) 业务定义: Independent secondary metric per OD-05; keep separate from npl_balance_rate. 公式: npl_customer_count / active_customer_count * 100
指标[余额逾期率环比变化] (overdue_balance_rate_pp_change) 业务定义: PP change of Owner-approved overdue_balance_rate; formula unchanged. 公式: overdue_balance_rate_t - overdue_balance_rate_t1
指标[余额不良率环比变化] (npl_balance_rate_pp_change) 业务定义: PP change of Owner-approved npl_balance_rate; formula unchanged. 公式: npl_balance_rate_t - npl_balance_rate_t1
